title: Learn anything
subtitle: Type a topic. Pip plans the direction with you, then writes a substantial course around your time and learning preferences.
anythingGoes: Cooking chemistry, tax basics, a programming language. Anything goes.
coursesShowHere: Courses Pip makes for you show up here. Only you can see them.

matches.title: Public courses that may fit
matches.subtitle: Pip found courses in the public library that look close to what you asked for. View one, or save your setup as a draft and decide later.
matches.none: Save as draft and continue later
matches.noneHint: Nothing is generated yet. A saved draft can be resumed or changed from Learn anything.

draft.title: Course draft
draft.subtitle: Your configuration is saved. Generate the course when you are ready.
draft.savedNote: This draft keeps your topic, time, style and format choices. It is removed after the outline is created.
draft.listSubtitle: Pick up where you left off, or change the setup before generating.

extension.title: Build from what you've learned
extension.subtitle: Pick one to three completed chapters, tell Pip what still feels unclear, and get a short extension course.
extension.chaptersHint: Only chapters you have finished are listed. Choose up to three.
extension.confusionHint: Optional. Mention the exact part that did not click.
extension.confusionPlaceholder: For example: I understand what delegation means, but I still cannot decide what should stay human.
extension.goal: What do you want from this course?
extension.goalProject: Apply it in a small project
extension.outlineNote: You will review the outline before any lessons are generated.
extension.outlineSource: This outline builds on {count} completed chapter(s) and your confusion notes.
extension.intro: This course will build on the chapters below. Pip will not simply repeat them — it will connect and extend the ideas.
extension.emptyHint: Finish at least one lesson, then come back to build a course from it.

form.topicLabel: What do you want to learn?
form.topicPlaceholder: e.g. How the stock market works
examples: How vaccines train your immune system
form.whyLabel: Why do you want to learn this?
form.whyHint: Optional. Pip picks examples that fit.
form.whyPlaceholder: e.g. I start an internship at a bank next month
form.timeLabel: How much time do you have?
form.timeHint: Pip fits the number of lessons to this budget.
form.customHoursHint: 0.25–20 hours per course. For a longer programme, split it into 2–3 courses.
form.splitTitle: {hours} hours is longer than one course
form.splitBody: A single course is capped at {hours} hours. Split the plan into smaller courses:
form.splitNote: First choose a split above, then finish the remaining preferences and click Generate series framework.
form.seriesPlanning: Pip is planning the full programme…
form.chooseSeriesPrompt: Choose a split option first, then click Generate series framework.
form.lessonCountHint: Leave it on automatic to derive the count from your time.
form.styleHint: Choose the teaching style that keeps you engaged.
form.formatLabel: What format should the course use?
form.formatHint: Choose one or more. Shift-click to select a range.
form.assessmentLabel: How do you want to check your learning?
form.assessmentHint: Pip chooses activities and a final check that match this.
form.planningTitle: Pip is planning the course direction…
form.planningNote: You will review the framework before the full lessons are written.
form.writingNote: Short lessons plus a few activities. You will land on it when it is ready.
form.limitReached: That is {limit} courses today. Pip can make more tomorrow.

generate.title: Pip is writing your course
generate.subtitle: The framework is approved. Pip writes one substantial lesson at a time so you can see progress.
generate.waiting: Writing the next lesson… This can take a minute.
generate.ready: Ready to write the next lesson.
generate.error: Pip stopped while writing a lesson.

outline.outcomesTitle: What you will be able to do
outline.approveNote: Pip will write the full lessons and activities from this framework.
outline.adjustNote: Tell Pip what to change; only the framework is regenerated, not the full course.
outline.adjustPlaceholder: e.g. more real-world examples, less theory, a harder final task
outline.limitError: You have reached today's course limit. Try again tomorrow.

feedback.readyNote: Open it, try an activity, then come back and tell Pip what to improve.
feedback.seriesNote: This course is part of a longer programme.
feedback.title: How was the course?
feedback.subtitle: Your feedback shapes the next generation; it is not just a rating.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: e.g. more examples, less jargon, a harder final task
feedback.lessonFeedbackLabel: What should change in this lesson?
feedback.lessonFeedbackPlaceholder: e.g. explain the example more slowly

series.outcomesTitle: What the complete programme gives you
series.regenerateNote: Tell Pip what to change across the whole programme. This only re-plans the framework.
series.regeneratePlaceholder: e.g. put the practical chapters earlier; make the third course more advanced
series.orderError: Complete the previous course before starting this one.
series.partError: Pip could not write this course. Go back and try again.
series.footer: Each course finishes its own chapters before the next one starts.
